ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Get Local Groups Information
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects the use of PowerShell modules and cmdlets to gather local group information.
Adversaries may use local system permission groups to determine which groups exist and which users belong to a particular group such as the local administrators group.
 Note: Unmapped fields: Payload, ContextInfo

sequences.query: ((Payload = RGX(".*get\\-localgroup\\ .*") OR Payload = RGX(".*get\\-localgroupmember\\ .*")) OR (ContextInfo = RGX(".*get\\-localgroup\\ .*") OR ContextInfo = RGX(".*get\\-localgroupmember\\ .*"))) OR (((Payload = RGX(".*get\\-wmiobject\\ .*") OR Payload = RGX(".*gwmi\\ .*") OR Payload = RGX(".*get\\-ciminstance\\ .*") OR Payload = RGX(".*gcim\\ .*")) OR (ContextInfo = RGX(".*get\\-wmiobject\\ .*") AND ContextInfo = RGX(".*gwmi\\ .*") AND ContextInfo = RGX(".*get\\-ciminstance\\ .*") AND ContextInfo = RGX(".*gcim\\ .*"))) AND (Payload = RGX(".*win32\\_group.*") OR ContextInfo = RGX(".*win32\\_group.*")))
